name: @btkulka/scaffold
description: Starts a new app of Ben's the way the others are built: a plan (name, kind, vertical, the BPM packages it builds on, the questions still open), the project files for that kind (Electron, web, service, CLI, MCP server, Discord bot or a shared package), a placeholder icon in the Benhäus app-icon style, and the brief that hands the work to Claude Code. Benhäus's New app screen runs it; the btkulka-scaffold command runs it from a terminal. No runtime dependencies.
